description.value: The Liquor Co. 1977 is a community-owned liquor retailer operating under Peninsula Co-op, a Vancouver Island cooperative with roots dating to 1977. The Selby Street Nanaimo location is one of roughly ten Vancouver Island stores, stocking beer, wine, and spirits with emphasis on local and Canadian producers. Co-op members earn rebates on purchases, offering ongoing value for anyone passing through and looking to resupply.
